verdict.rationale: Ardent's evidence documents creating, inspecting and deleting isolated Postgres branches. Nothing shows a command or API to reset an existing branch from its parent or restore it to an earlier point in time. A community comment names slow reverts as the real pain point, but the evidence gives no answer showing Ardent solves it. Recreating a fresh branch is a different capability from resetting or restoring one, so the axis applies and there is no direct support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reset a branch from its parent or restore it to an earlier state without rebuilding from a dump
